map.├── 和 └── 的区别是什么？: What is the difference between ├── and └──?
map.├── 表示该节点后面还有同级兄弟，└── 表示它是父节点的最后一个子项。父级是: ├── means the node still has siblings at the same level, while └── marks it as the last child of its parent. The same distinction decides whether the parent's vertical line │ continues: it stops after the last child, so the tree never ends up with dangling lines.
